ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is made and entered into as of this _1_ day of _Sept ,2025, by and between SJ 161, LLC, a limited liability company organized and existing under the laws of the State of __ New YorkxF ("SJ 161"), and SJ 163, LLC,a limited liability company organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York*  ("SJ 163"). RECITALS WHEREAS, SJ 161 is the fee owner of that certain parcel of real property located at __161 Attorneystreet,NY,NY10002 .(Block _350, Lot 67_) in the Borough of manhattan_, City and State of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit A. attached hereto and made a part hereof (the "SJ 161 Parcel"); and WHEREAS, SJ 163 is the fee owner of that certain parcel of real property located at -_163 Attorney street (Block _350_,Lot 66 in the Borough of _Manhattan City and State of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit B attached hereto and made a part hereof (the"SJ 163 Parcel"); and WHEREAS, the SJ 161 Parcel and the SJ 163 Parcel are contiguous to one another; and WHEREAS, the Parties desire to merge the SJ 161 Parcel and the SJ 163 Parcel into a single zoning lot pursuant to Section 12-10 of the New York City Zoning Resolution (the "Zoning Resolution") to create a merged zoning lot (the "Merged Zoning Lot"); and WHEREAS, the primary purpose of creating the Merged Zoning Lot is to comply with the "sliver law" requirements set forth in Section 23-692 of the Zoning Resolution, which requires a minimum street frontage of forty (40) feet; and WHEREAS, the Parties desire to maintain their respective development rights associated with their respective Parcels, notwithstanding the creation of the Merged Zoning Lot; and WHEREAS, the Parties desire to set forth their respective rights and obligations with respect to the Merged Zoning Lot. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties, intending to be legally bound, hereby agree as follows:

1. MERGER OF THE ZONING LOT 1.1 Creation of Merged Zoning Lot. The Parties hereby agree to merge the SJ 161 Parcel and the SJ 163 Parcel to create the Merged Zoning Lot in accordance with the provisions of Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. The Parties shall execute and deliver a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions in the form required by the New York City Department of Buildings (the "DOB") and shall cause such Declaration to be recorded in the Office of the City Register of New York County (the "City Register"). 1.2 Zoning Lot Certification. The Parties shall cooperate in good faith to obtain a Zoning Lot Certification from the Chair of the City Planning Commission pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution confirming the creation of the Merged Zoning Lot. 2. DEVELOPMENT RIGHTS 2.1 Retention of Development Rights. Notwithstanding the creation of the Merged Zoning Lot, each Party shall retain all development rights (including floor area, bulk, height, setback, and other zoning rights) attributable to its respective Parcel prior to the creation of the Merged Zoning Lot. For clarity, SJ 161 shall retain all development rights attributable to the SJ 161 Parcel, and SJ 163 shall retain all development rights attributable to the SJ 163 Parcel. 2.2 No Transfer of Development Rights. Neither Party shall be deemed to have transferred any development rights to the other Party as a result of this Agreement or the creation of the Merged ZoningLot. 2.3 Future Development. Each Party shall be entitled to develop its respective Parcel in accordance with the Zoning Resolution and other applicable laws and regulations, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement. 3.COMPLIANCE WITHSLIVERLAW 3.1 Purpose of Merger. The Parties acknowledge and agree that the primary purpose of creating the Merged Zoning Lot is to comply with the "sliver law" requirements set forth in Section 23- 692 of the Zoning Resolution, which requires a minimum street frontage of forty (40) feet. 3.2 Combined Frontage. The Parties represent that the combined street frontage of the SJ 161 Parcel and the SJ 163 Parcel exceeds forty (40) feet, thereby satisfying the minimum frontage requirement ofSection23-692of theZoningResolution. 4.COOPERATION 4.1 General Cooperation.
